nom: e.l.f. Cosmetics Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with dry eyelids, generally find the cream hydrating enough for the under-eye area and helpful when winter dryness sets in, though one warns that those with very dry skin might want a thicker cream at night, and dry-eyelid skin can develop milia if the cream is applied too far up rather than just under the eye.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some with rosacea or eyes normally sensitive to eye products, mostly report zero irritation, stinging or breakouts; one reviewer instead had her eyes almost swell shut after her first use and warns other sensitive users to be careful.
segments.mature: The few reviewers who mention their age (40s) report the cream feels nice and helps with dark circles or puffiness, and one specifically notices her fine lines improving; another review frames the formula as best suited to younger skin, suggesting those wanting stronger anti-aging or deeper moisture may find it basic.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers with fine lines and wrinkles under the eyes report no visible change after use, and one review flags the formula as feeling basic for anyone wanting a stronger anti-aging effect; one reviewer instead notices her fine lines improving with consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe the cream as hydrating and moisturizing without feeling heavy or greasy, including some who specifically use it for dry under-eye skin or dry winter conditions; one reviewer instead finds the hydration doesn't last as long as other products and needs reapplying more often.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, report no stinging, burning or irritation; one reviewer instead reports her eyes were almost swollen shut the morning after her first use and warns sensitive users to be careful.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention their dark circles report the tinted, vitamin-C formula visibly brightens and evens out the under-eye area, some comparing it favorably to pricier creams they've used for years; several others, including a few who say they don't have much under-eye darkening to begin with, report no visible brightening even after weeks of consistent use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers say the cream doesn't break them out, and one specifically confirms it caused no milia; two others report small bumps or a pimple when they applied too much or used it beyond the under-eye area onto the eyelids, an issue tied to the dimethicone in the formula and resolved by using less.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the texture as lightweight and non-greasy, absorbing quickly without leaving an oily film or heavy residue, even those layering it under makeup.

extraits.titre: Do not use if your sensitive
extraits.texte: Tried this yesterday and this morning my eyes are almost swollen shut. I was also sensitive to the Ole Henrikson banana eye cream years ago- so I should have realized. Just be careful.

extraits.titre: Goes on smoot. Light scent. Did not see results.
extraits.texte: I received this product for free in part for my review. The product goes on smoothly and you do not need to use a lot. This product will last a long time. I did not see any difference while using this product. I was hoping for any improvement. I do have fine lines and wrinkles under eye.

extraits.titre: Use ream in the undereye area ONLY if milia prone
extraits.texte: I tried the Bright + Brew-tiful Eye Cream because I have dry eyelids and undereye bags with slight discoloration. I liked that the cream has good slip and feels very comfortable in the eye area. Ingredients include vitamin C to brighten the appearance of dark circles, banana-tinted powder for instant radiance, and a 3% caffeine blend to help help visibly depuff tired-looking eyes. I had been applying about dots of the cream on my eyelids and under eye area and while I noticed some eye brightening and depuffing, I also started getting some milia (tiny white bumps) on my eyelids. I saw that dimethicone is the fifth ingredient in this eye cream and think my overzealous use of the product over my entire eye probably caused the milia. I stopped use of the eye cream to give my condition a chance to resolve itself and it did. Now I only use less than one dot of the eye cream just in my undereye area. I have yet to find an effective treatment for dry eyelids without the potential for milia. A tiny amount of this eye cream is fine and safe to use for the undereye area but don't overuse if you are milia prone.

This is a very good eye cream with Vitamin C. It will not remove my under-eye darkness, as this is part of my facial structure. It is hydrating and has not caused any irritation on my sensitive rosacea-prone skin.

I'm very satisfied with this eye cream so far, and am excited to see the results as I continue using it with more time. The cream feels nice on my skin when I put it under my eyes, and soaks into my skin well. There is a very faint scent, but it's not really noticeable which I like. It feels very moisturizing, and leaves the skin feeling soft. I've already noticed my fine lines around my eyes improving, and it's also helped with my dark circles. I like that it has caffeine in it because I think it's a big attribute. I have a hard time finding skin care products that really work, and am pleased to say this is one of them that shows results. I received this product free in exchange for my honest feedback.

I received a sample of this product and have used this for about a week. I have dry skin so my concealer tends to dry up throughout the day but this eye cream makes my makeup last way longer. It's a rich texture but it doesn't feel heavy or greasy. I like that it gives me a bit of extra hydration especially since the weather has been getting colder. Would recommend for people with dry skin!

I'm a 43 year old Black woman and I love this eye cream. I've noticed a difference in both my dark undereyes and puffiness. I love the way it feels and it doesn't take much to for my skin to feel hydrated and moisturized. It's a been addition to my routine
